name: optimizer
description: A/B testing harness for Claude Code plugins. Creates experiment environments, pins every declared artifact per arm to an immutable snapshot, launches paired control/test sessions with everything-else-equal configs, and produces comparative analysis (deterministic metrics + rubric-scored quality + LLM contextualization) across five pillars — quality, input tokens, output tokens, turns, autonomy. Accumulates run-over-run into a hypothesis ledger, a regression series, and a generated write-up.

experiments_root.title: Experiments root directory
experiments_root.description: Folder where optimizer creates and stores A/B experiment environments (kept outside any plugin/project repo — env.json, seed files, run history, transcripts). Example: C:\Users\you\claude-experiments or ~/claude-experiments. Run /optimizer:setup any time to set or change this.
